device.description: 18-bit 100 kSPS true-differential microPower SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial interface and daisy-chain
device.note: ads8887.pdf (SBAS613A) p.3 conversion time, p.4 power-supply requirements, p.5 3-wire timing (Figure 1, Table 1), p.9 pin configurations and assignments, p.19 ADC transfer function (twos complement), digital interface, p.20 3-wire CS mode

pages: p.3 (tconv 500-8800 ns), p.4 (AVDD 2.7-3.6 V, DVDD 1.65-3.6 V), p.5 (3-wire timing, Figure 1, Table 1), p.9 (pins), p.19 (transfer function, interface modes), p.20 (3-wire CS mode)
notModeled: analog input and reference (the 0 V differential code is 00000h, twos complement)
mode selection by the DIN level at the CONVST rising edge: only 3-wire CS mode without a busy indicator (DIN high, CONVST as CS) is modeled; DIN is not read
4-wire CS mode (DIN as CS), busy indicator bit, daisy-chain mode (DIN as chain input)
DOUT driven while CONVST is low during a conversion (modeled: the frame shows the last result)
conversion time varies 500-8800 ns (modeled: tconv max 8800 ns); acquisition time, 100 kSPS throughput limit, automatic power-down between conversions
SCLK frequency limit 16 MHz, quiet time
